pages.title: Closed Timelike Curve
pages.text: A path through spacetime that ends where, and when, it began. Godel showed such loops are allowed in general relativity under certain conditions. In the hand it is a looping thread of light that I keep trying to follow, and keep losing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Causality Loop Engine, a Superintelligence Core worked out how to make a loop without paradox. I sent a curve back along itself with Chronon Gas, and found it already waiting. Paradox Echoes drop them too.
